## Walks on the streets

Four answers of Transitous (`MOTIS v2.11.4`) to the walk the engine asks, taken on 11/11/2026
between 07:56 and 07:58 UTC with the same generic `User-Agent`, whole and re-indented by
Prettier. Each asks `https://api.transitous.org/api/v6/plan?fromPlace=<from>&toPlace=<to>&transitModes=&directModes=WALK&pedestrianProfile=<profile>&maxDirectTime=3600`:

| File                              | Downloaded (UTC) | From, to, profile                              | Content                                                                        |
| --------------------------------- | ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `transitous-walk-foot.json`       | 07:56:48         | `40.7553,-73.9876`, `40.7542,-73.9846`, `FOOT` | Times Square to Bryant Park: 300 m in 255 s, 42 points                         |
| `transitous-walk-wheelchair.json` | 07:57:57         | The same corners, `WHEELCHAIR`                 | 300 m in 381 s                                                                 |
| `transitous-walk-creek.json`      | 07:57:45         | `40.7352,-73.947`, `40.7385,-73.947`, `FOOT`   | Across Newtown Creek: 367 m in a straight line, 1,788 m in 1,510 s by a bridge |
| `transitous-walk-none.json`       | 07:57:59         | `40.758,-73.9535`, `40.758,-73.959`, `FOOT`    | Roosevelt Island to Manhattan: no walk within an hour (`direct` empty)         |

The streets, the metres and the paths come from OpenStreetMap through Transitous: © OpenStreetMap
contributors, under the Open Database License (ODbL 1.0, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright).
They are kept here only as test data, with this attribution.

## AeroDataBox

AeroDataBox's answers are not kept. Its Terms of Use (`https://aerodatabox.com/terms/`, section 5)
say "in no event shall you retain a copy of Contents for a period exceeding the greater of: seven
(7) consecutive calendar days" (or the `Cache-Control` `max-age` of the answer), and "Contents"
covers "any copy, extract, excerpt, transcription, paraphrase, translation, or reformatting" of
the data. So the answers for one flight and for the JFK board are written by hand in the
documented shape, with invented times, aircraft and flights: only flight numbers known from
elsewhere stay (AA 100, the one the tests ask for, and those of the call signs in the adsb.lol
capture, ODbL). The tests check every field the reader uses against the official schema kept
beside them (the OpenAPI has no example of its own); test values built from those field names
cover the other cases (a gate, a predicted time, a cargo flight, the failures).

The two real requests of 11/11/2026 (03:51 UTC for AA 100, 05:39:49 UTC for the JFK board, 2 units
each of the 400 a month) left only their gateway headers here, which carry no flight data: the
tier, the units left and when the month restarts.
